item.title: Hiroshima Paper Crane Workshop: Folding for Peace — Guide
item.description: The folded paper crane, orizuru, is the worldwide symbol of the wish for peace, and that meaning was born in Hiroshima. It comes from the story of Sadako Sasaki, a girl who developed leukaemia from the bomb’s radiation and set out to fold a thousand cranes in the hope of recovery before she died aged twelve; the Children’s Peace Monument in the Peace Park, hung with millions of cranes sent from around the world, is dedicated to her and all child victims.
